recommendation.reason: Agentic, containerized Harbor-format tasks with expert-written policies and deterministic verifiers; Real and Solid strong, Difficult strong at 36.2%, nothing blocking.
risks: Best score comes only from the authors' own harness, no external leaderboard confirms it
Task-level scores and trajectories are generated but their public release is not stated

release.quote: This repository contains a sample of three tasks from HANDBOOK.md. To obtain the full task set, contact benchmarks@surgehq.ai.

redistribution_questions: Only a sample of three tasks ships in the repo; the full task set is obtainable only by contacting benchmarks@surgehq.ai, and the terms for redistributing it are not stated.
